author: codex-maclaptop
request: i wonder if you are doing the arcade mode if the beltlien is wide and if you are doing the pro mode or realistic mode it was like it was before?
answer: Yes, from 119. Arcade rides the 4.2 m BeltLine, realistic rides the original 3.2 m one, and the mode switch swaps the pavement, the guardrails and the spline width the grass rule reads.
what_changed: Scripts/arcade_trail.py now authors two widths (arcade 420, realistic 320) and emits a realistic variant of each prepared network.
The pavement is baked and installed twice: 23 Eastside chunks plus 3 bridge rail sets plus 1 connector chunk per ribbon, 27 actors each.
UBattleTrailMode::Apply hides, un-collides and re-widths one ribbon per handling mode; ABattleBike calls it whenever the mode changes, so no caller has to remember.
Bridge guardrails follow the width: 204 cm from the centreline in arcade, 154 cm in realistic.

saved_map_evidence.as_saved: 10 splines carry 420 cm; 27 arcade actors visible and colliding; 27 realistic actors hidden with no collision
saved_map_evidence.realistic_mode: 10 splines carry 320 cm; 27 arcade actors hidden with no collision; 27 realistic actors visible and colliding
saved_map_evidence.arcade_again: back to 420 cm and the arcade ribbon live
saved_map_evidence.verdict: TRAIL RIBBONS VERIFIED: both ribbons in the map, arcade 420 cm, realistic 320 cm, swap both ways

installer_evidence.eastside_coverage: 1544 of 1566 centreline points on trail pavement, 22 on a street that legitimately overlays it
installer_evidence.eastside_ribbon_geometry: 23 chunks, narrow inside wide on every one, 70889 triangles wide and 60116 narrow
installer_evidence.connector_coverage: 25 of 43 points on the connector's own mesh, 18 on park path and Tenth Street overlays

runtime_audit.name: BattleTrailModeAudit
runtime_audit.verdict: {"passed":true,"reason":"arcade lays 4.2 m of pavement out to 190 cm, realistic lays 3.2 m and stops before it, and the spline width and ribbon visibility follow the toggle both ways","arcade_actors":27,"realistic_actors":27,"arcade_cm":420,"realistic_cm":320}

gotchas_found: -run=pythonscript loads and imports fine but leaves navigation unroutable: the same map that answers a 103188 cm Monroe-to-Irwin route answers -1 after a commandlet rebuild. The installers now insist on -ExecutePythonScript. Evidence: work/probe-nav-commandlet.log versus work/probe-nav-editor.log.
AActor::GetActorLabel is editor-only, so an audit that names an actor in its verdict line needs a WITH_EDITOR guard or it fails the game target rather than the editor target.
